title: Boku no Kokoro no Yabai Yatsu: Twi-Yaba
justification: AniList 170221 (ONA, 1 episode(s) from 2023-12-10) is AniDB 18066's special S1, aired 2023-12-11. AniDB files it under the season 2 entry because it aired the month before season 2; AniList's PARENT relation names AniList 153152 (season 1, AniDB 17547), but AniDB 18066 lists MAL 56948, this entry's MAL id, and the special's title "Bonus Dangers" (Japanese "Twi-Yaba") matches AniList's synonym "The Dangers in My Heart: Bonus Dangers" and its romaji "Twi-Yaba". The parent's node places S1 on TVDB 0x01 "Bonus Dangers", 2023-12-10, 21 min, and TMDB 207250, where the parent's node places the special, agrees: S0E1 "Bonus Dangers", 2023-12-10, 21m.
